channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Nasdaq falls more than 2% as investors rotate out of tech after Amazon, Intel earnings: Live updates
item.description: Amazon and Intel shares tumbled after the companies posted their latest earnings reports.

item.title: $6.3 billion Binance hack is largest crypto theft on record
item.description: Binance says a security breach impacted about $6.3 billion in assets. The exchange says roughly $3 billion has been frozen and losses will be covered.

item.title: Wall Street braces for Democratic gains as 2026 midterm election nears
item.description: Investors are preparing for a blue wave in the midterm election on Tuesday that will determine who controls Congress for the remainder of President Trump's term.

item.title: 'Bad time to troll': Binance cofounder Changpeng Zhao asks Elon Musk for 'respect' after post about bitcoin hack
item.description: Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao asked Elon Musk to stop “trolling” after a $6.3 billion hack, pointing to Binance’s $1 billion-plus SpaceX stake.

item.title: Treasury Department announces new Series I bond rate of 5.51% for the next six months
item.description: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has announced new Series I bond rates through April 2027.

item.title: Here are the stocks reporting next week that have a history of earnings beats and big share gains
item.description: These stocks reporting next week typically beat Wall Street numbers and see their stocks rally afterward.

item.title: Chevron and Exxon beat earnings expectations as refining profits soar on high diesel fuel prices
item.description: Diesel prices have surged globally as Ukraine and Iran have bombed refineries in Russia and the Middle East.

item.title: Trump, Vance scrap planned appearances in final stretch of midterm campaign
item.description: Trump and JD Vance have canceled planned appearances across three states, reducing in-person campaigning in the final days before midterm elections.

item.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack: What we know and what comes next
item.description: Billions in crypto assets have been frozen following a potential Binance security breach, raising questions about whether the funds can be recovered.

item.title: Musk and Zuckerberg echo Trump's push to rebrand AI as 'super intelligence' on earnings calls. Others did not
item.description: Meta's Mark Zuckerberg and Elon Musk of Tesla and SpaceX adopted President Trump's preferred "super intelligence" term on their third-quarter earnings calls.

item.title: Gamble on democracy: Inside suspicious election-contracts trading on prediction markets
item.description: Prediction markets' failure to call an LA primary correctly raised the possibility they can be manipulated to exaggerate the amount of support candidates have.

item.title: Gen Z is ditching bars for run clubs — and finding more than friends along the way
item.description: As young adults denote less wallet share to bars, run clubs, races and recreational leagues become increasingly popular places to build community.

item.title: Swiss central bank posts bumper $23 billion profit thanks to gold, foreign assets
item.description: Unlike other major central banks, the Swiss National Bank has a significant equity portfolio.

item.title: Tech giants need legacy businesses to keep growing as they pour trillions into the AI buildout
item.description: Hyperscalers continue spending big on artificial intelligence, putting pressure on their legacy businesses and impacting their free cash flow.

item.title: Intel issued weaker-than-expected guidance. Analysts are losing confidence in the stock
item.description: Intel issued a weaker-than-expected outlook for the current quarter amid a slowdown in global PC sales, leading several analysts to lower their price targets on the stock.

item.title: A pharma giant is moving past one patent cliff — but another is already looming
item.description: Disappointing data highlights Novartis' challenge to build its next generation of blockbuster medicines, following a series of clinical trial setbacks.

item.title: Russian strikes plunge Ukrainian city into blackout as Zelenskyy warns of more missile attacks
item.description: Russian strikes caused major power outages in Dnipro as a reported Ukrainian drone attack sparked a fire at a Russian oil refinery.

item.title: Iran claims four tankers struck mines in Hormuz as strike fears grow after U.S. midterms
item.description: Iran said four tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, while Tehran disputed a U.S. claim that key shipping lanes had been cleared.

item.title: The big questions remaining after Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO prospectus
item.description: Uncertainties remain ahead of one of the most hotly anticipated IPOs in history.

item.title: Starbucks sales miss expectations, but its U.S. turnaround is gaining steam
item.description: Starbucks' U.S. stores topped Wall Street's comparable sales expectations but its international business fell short of estimates.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Friday
item.description: Intel dashes hopes of quick turnaround in tech.

item.title: The best ways to earn and use cash back for your holiday shopping
item.description: Earning and redeeming cash back can make this holiday season more affordable — here's how to use it effectively.

item.title: Rivian's stock correction allows favorable 'entry point' after Q3 earnings, Jefferies says
item.description: Rivian is a buy, as the path to profitability for the EV company becomes clearer, according to Jefferies.

item.title: Rivian third-quarter earnings beat estimates as software revenue, R2 deliveries rise
item.description: Rivian also revised its 2026 guidance to mark expected improvements in its vehicle deliveries, pre-tax adjusted earnings and capital expenditures.

item.title: Foxconn hopes to own 50% of the global AI server market within a couple years
item.description: Foxconn's chairman told CNBC that AI demand remains strong as the company eyes U.S. expansion and a larger share of the global AI server market.

item.title: Reddit shares sink on weak sales guidance and plans login requirement test as Google search traffic shrinks
item.description: Reddit posts third-quarter earnings and reveals plans to require all users to create official accounts as Google search traffic shrinks

item.title: Cruise companies aim to keep fuel costs down. Their strategies for doing so differ
item.description: Carnival is cutting fuel use, while Royal Caribbean and Norwegian rely on "hedging" to keep fuel costs down amid conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: BP’s third-quarter profit nearly quadruples to $8.5 billion as refining margins surge
item.description: The oil major was the latest to smash profit expectations as global conflicts continue to drive energy market volatility.

item.title: Euro zone economy slows to 0.4% growth in Q3 as crisis-hit France contracts
item.description: The euro zone showed surprising resilience, but weak productivity, industrial competitiveness challenges and demographic pressures remain, analysts said.

item.title: Jim Cramer says Microsoft is winning the AI spending battle — and Alphabet is paying the price
item.description: Cramer called Microsoft a buy after strong earnings, while remaining more cautious on Alphabet.
